basic_info.description: I'm Hanane Yacoubi, 23 years old, and freshly armed with a Master’s degree in Software Development Engineering. With a solid foundation in web development, algorithm design, and software engineering, I’m driven by the thrill of solving puzzles and building solutions that make life easier—or at least cooler. From designing clean, efficient code to tackling complex algorithms, my journey has been fueled by curiosity, persistence, and, of course, a lot of caffeine 💻☕. I’m passionate about creating innovative solutions and constantly pushing myself to learn and grow in this ever-evolving field.
